about.title: About
about.motivation1: AI news drops everywhere every day — scrolling manually is exhausting and easy to miss. AI Daily Pulse fetches from 40+ RSS sources, pre-filters, scores with AI, deduplicates, and produces a daily Chinese digest.
about.motivation2: Focus areas: OPC / solo-founder monetization, AI + e-commerce, tools & agent workflows, new tech & models, and funding rounds.
about.motivation3: This site is the online reading UI for those digests — browse and search history without opening Markdown files each time.
about.authorBio: Independent developer focused on AI news aggregation and solo-founder workflows.
